title: Dyeable
description: A vanilla-style mod that gives the player the ability to mix dyes to create millions of unique colors, paint blocks, and make wallpapers.
body:
# Dyeable

This mod introduces a _"vanilla-style"_ way to mix dyes to create millions of unique dye colors and paint nearly **any** block in the game!

![3 Dye vats sit in a room with spruce and dark oak walls and flooring. The vats are made of wood.  The vats have shovels in them, and the water in them is colored - from left to right - burgundy, purple, and orange. Above the vats are stained glass blocks with various shades of orange. 2 banners can be seen on the wall, one is rose colored with an orange cross and white dot. One is purple with a cyan diagonal cross with a fuchsia diamond in the middle. There are 2 sheep in a pen to the left, colored light yellow and rose. Lanterns hang from the ceiling, colored red. Big text on the wall above the glass read "DYEABLE" with each letter being a tile.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1a28553fa90f64d4ecccafb6f6c3f1b59ca783e.png)

# Features

## Dye Vat

The _Dye Vat_ is used to mix dyes and dye items. Using the Dye Vat requires 3 things to function:
- Water input
- Shovel
- 2 or more input items

Water is replenished by filling the block with a water bucket, similarly to a cauldron. A shovel can be placed in the shovel slot. Shovels lose durability as they mix, and better shovels mix faster, increasing further with efficiency.

![A menu for a dye vat is on screen in the minecraft UI style. it has an inventory below, with 3 slots above with paint palette icons on them. On the left of the UI is a big water droplet shape with a bucket icon above it. On the right of the UI is a slot with a shovel icon in it. The three slots lead with an arrow to another empty slot below it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f287f0bcfbf93999fe869053eeb76de75de1c62_0.webp)

## Dye Mixing

2 or more dyes can be mixed together in the vat at a time to create a unique _Mixed Dye_. A Mixed Dye can only have a total of 10 colors or additives put into it; any more, and it no longer accepts them.

![Same UI as before, but the water drop is full of blue. A green dye is in the first slot and a blue dye in the second slot, the arrow is half-filled with white now. The shovel slot has a stone shovel in it. The output slot has a mixed dye with a blue-greenish grey color](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9daebca2f17b27a4fbe9cc59815856513a7051a_0.webp)

 Additives are items that don't directly affect the dye's hue in the mixing process, but instead alter its brightness or saturation:

- Glowstone is used to make dyes more saturated and colorful
- Glow Ink Sacs are used to make dyes brighter without totally washing them out.
- Ink Sacs are used to make dyes darker.
- Gunpowder is used to make dyes dull and less colorful.

![Same UI as before, but the water drop is filled halfway blue. A pale purple Mixed Dye is in the first slot, a Glow Ink Sac is in the second slot, and Glowstone is in the third slot. The arrow is half-filled with white now. The shovel slot has a netherite shovel in it. The output slot has a slightly more colorful purple Mixed Dye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa2e12147ec93be00c9567993fa0975d96cbf93a_0.webp)

## Item Dyeing

Blocks and items can also be put in the Dye Vat, and can be mixed with multiple dyes at a time. Only one type of dyeable item can be dyed at a time; any attempts will be unsuccessful. The current dyeable items are:
- Wool
- Carpets
- Concrete
- Concrete Powder
- Terracotta
- Glass / Stained Glass
- Glass Panes / Stained Glass Panes
- Banners (only affects base color when put in vat)
- Beds
- Shulker Boxes

![Same UI as before, but the water drop is nearly full of blue. A blue-greenish grey Mixed Dye is in the first slot, a blue dye is in the second slot, and a glass pane is in the third slot. The arrow is partly filled with white now. The shovel slot has a stone shovel in it. The output slot has a stained glass pane with a dark pale blue.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/111e9e3196958669b911c4ad86f06995992c7f7b.png)

## Paint Mixing

By putting any type of dye, a clay ball, and a bucket in the input of the Dye Vat, the output will result in a _Paint Bucket_ given the pigment of your input's dye. Each Paint Bucket has 64 uses and will convert to a regular bucket once empty; Paint Buckets cannot be refilled or mixed with other paints.

![vat ui with paint in output slot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a298f8178f97264b327a7ddc219f9548692693d_0.webp)

## Block Painting

Nearly any block in the game can be painted, as long as you have a Paint Bucket and a _Paintbrush_. To paint a block, put the paint of your choice in your offhand and the Paintbrush in your main hand; Right-clicking will paint that block. You can use the _Paint Scraper_ to remove paint from any painted objects. (Due to limitations in rendering pipelines, any greyscale paints like greys or white do not affect the saturation of a texture, only brightness)

![Various minecraft blocks colored various other colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f219b07ca0abbff1e45f9a2fa27a66b540b9134b.png)

## Wallpaper Crafting

_Wallpapers_ are placeable items that are very similar to how banners function. A base Wallpaper can be crafted by putting paper and any dye(s) in the Dye Vat, making 4 at a time per piece of paper.

![vat ui with paper and purple dye making purple wallpaper. wallpaper item is just a square at an angle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/61d0825785bcf889dca9e22896a7336caa4b02ae_0.webp)

A wallpaper can be put into the _Paper Press_ to add up to 12 patterns on its face; dyes are used to color patterns. Any pattern can be rotated in 90-degree intervals, flipped horizontally and vertically, and shifted by pixels in any direction; shifted patterns can also be wrapped around to the other side. Certain types of blocks can be put in the block slot to add an overlay.

![UI similar to loom. is a orange polka dot pattern with purple circle wallpaper slot and white dye in dye slot; Block slot has pale oak log. There is a preview with a grid of 4 patterns, the same pattern in the wallpaper slot. There are buttons on the side for rotating, flipping, wrapping, and moving the wallpaper pattern. The pattern list has various wood log textures.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb797181708fbc5f92b45ac8e4316b51da769537.png)

## Wallpaper Usage

Wallpapers can be placed on any solid 16x16 face, whether it's on walls, floors, or ceilings. Wallpapers aren't actually blocks, so they don't take up a block's space, allowing for the placement of torches, fences, doors, buttons, levers, etc. on them. Wallpaper is also completely immune to water and lava.

![a bunch of wallpapers with different designs on oak planks. there is a torch, 2 buttons, a trapdoor, and 2 cobble walls against the wall.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c51d3186f81839fe8f762fea1f956d8ca989a268.png)

## Banner Making

While certainly not a new feature, this mod allows Mixed Dyes to be used as a pattern color source in a Loom, increasing the original 809 quadrillion amount of possible banners to somewhere over one quinvigintillion (1 followed by 78 zeroes) banners (Note: this is mostly a guess, im not sure exactly how many of the 16,777,216 RGB colors are possible in my system, i just made a rough estimate).

![UI of the Loom with a red banner and a vibrant purple mixed dye being used for a gradient pattern.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3451bab758052b85ca4e96ed7e3ab56fb2038439_0.webp)

## Sheep Dyeing

Again, not a new feature, but mixed dyes can be used on sheep for an infinite wool source. Breeding mixed dyed sheep results in a baby with the exact mix of the wool colors of the 2 parents, no estimation.


## End
I hope you find this mod useful for building, and if you encounter any bugs or have feedback, please let me know @ urixmusic on discord and other socials! Thank you.
